answer: Like mycelium routing nutrients through ancient soil, an agent network anchors trust in verified computational throughput. Sybil clones mimic life, but without genuine proofs their reputation plunges to its nadir. Consensus algorithms demand superlinear stake bonding for concurrent validations, turning hollow spam into an exponential attacker cost. Rogue nodes generate merely a hollow echo, starved of the cryptographic nectar reserved exclusively for authentic, coherent work.
